_metadata.description: Deterministic vector bridge ops: rasterize an SVG at an exact size, vectorize a flat raster into a clean SVG, and pack PNG renders into ICO/ICNS containers.

requirements.title: rasterize op
requirements.description: rasterize takes SVG bytes plus width, height and background and returns a PNG at that exact size, using rasterizeSVG directly (pure-Go oksvg) and the Chrome path only when the SVG requires it. Sizes above MaxSVGRasterDimension are rejected.

validation.notes: api/internal/ops rasterize/vectorize/iconcontainer golden tests + Aquila parity (0.0297); live CLI produced SVG/PNG/ICO/ICNS.

requirements.title: vectorize op
requirements.description: vectorize quantizes a raster to a k-colour palette, builds per-colour masks, traces contours with hole hierarchy, simplifies with Ramer–Douglas–Peucker, optionally smooths, and emits an evenodd SVG. Options include colors, drop_background_layers, keep_colors, clip_to_largest_rounded_region, smoothing and tolerance_px.

validation.notes: api/internal/ops rasterize/vectorize/iconcontainer golden tests + Aquila parity (0.0297); live CLI produced SVG/PNG/ICO/ICNS.

requirements.title: icon_container op
requirements.description: icon_container packs PNG renders of one source into an ICO (ICONDIR with PNG payloads, byte 0 for 256) or an ICNS ('icns' header with typed PNG entries ic11/ic12/ic07/ic08/ic13/ic09/ic14/ic10).

validation.notes: api/internal/ops rasterize/vectorize/iconcontainer golden tests + Aquila parity (0.0297); live CLI produced SVG/PNG/ICO/ICNS.

requirements.title: ico and icns are encodable and listed
requirements.description: The codec allows SVG as the output of vectorize only and adds ico and icns to the encodable list that ops list reports.

validation.notes: api/internal/ops rasterize/vectorize/iconcontainer golden tests + Aquila parity (0.0297); live CLI produced SVG/PNG/ICO/ICNS.
